reason: Serialized finisher order independently resolves seven CNL clutch log discrepancies and 34 opening-death player-map discrepancies. Broader cached evidence now supports 137 clutch wins, including 40 1v2, 11 1v3, three 1v4, one 1v5, versus 29 total in the rejected old study.
inputs: Original 688 corrected clean development rows plus all 300 permanently consumed CNL final rows. No regrading of any final. New 988-row cohort, 99 maps, ten whole events. No new Rating targets and no UAH input.
identity_quality: Original clean rows only; exact per-round header identities and normalized/native finisher-victim-clock-headshot parity, every native elimination offset positive and strictly increasing. Whole-map refusal if this fails. Original credited K/D and core objective gates unchanged.

formula.legacy_count: Unchanged corrected nine-family features with remaining-clock opening/clutch semantics as control
formula.native_count: Same nine families; native serialized first opposing finisher opening and first sole-survivor clutch count
formula.native_linear_size: Native nine families; clutch feature sum(X * clutch_1vX)/rounds
formula.native_triangular_size: Native nine families; clutch feature sum(X*(X+1)/2 * clutch_1vX)/rounds

complexity_policy: One clutch coefficient in each arm, no separately fitted size coefficients. Linear and triangular are fixed conventional monotone count transforms, not weights fitted to Direction/Cpk. Triangular is an exploratory increasing opponent-load hypothesis; sparse 1v4/5 support and extrapolation limits must be explicit. No coefficient/alpha/window search, clipping, operator guessing, row deletion, or per-event coefficients.
feature_limits: Credited count-derived KPR/MK/KOSTKill and supported objective signal preserved. Native opening explicitly measures FINISHER first opposing elimination, not inferred credited opening owner. Legacy trade and KOST trade flags retained under v2 compatibility; precise credited trades remain NOT READY. This does not change production chronology, action-start operators, or historical v2 snapshots.
fit_policy: Standardized ridge alpha=1; ten leave-whole-event-out folds, full event excluded including every map/player. Also exact immutable v2 coefficients on original compatible inputs. Fit each arm once; preserve all folds, errors, metrics, coefficients and drift. No new final event until qualification.
selection: Lowest pooled whole-event MAE among qualified arms, native_count preferred on exact tie. No final is consumed if no arm qualifies. An extreme-only improvement without broad event wins does not justify a size arm.

prospective_final_gate.subgroup_policy: Objective-positive and kill-credit-affected groups with >=10 rows each require MAE <=.05

historical_studies: Old 118/299-row linear clutch studies remain rejected; APAC/SAL/CNL final failures remain permanent, never rerun. CNL is now consumed development, not new independent accuracy.
